code:
Situation: analysts need revenue totals, never customer names
Wrong: a second catalog just for masked data
Right: a column mask on customer-name, scoped to a group
caption: One table, one source of truth, different views by role.

code:
Situation: millions of files/day, directory listing times out
Wrong: increase the listing timeout and hope
Right: switch to file notification mode
caption: Subscribes to storage events instead of listing the tree every run.

code:
Situation: drop negative order_total rows, keep the pipeline running
Wrong: @dlt.expect_or_fail (halts the whole run)
Right: @dlt.expect_or_drop
caption: Expectations can drop bad rows without failing the update.

code:
Task A -> Task B, Task C (parallel, both depend on A) -> Task D
Wrong: model it as one linear chain
Right: a dependency graph; D depends on BOTH B and C
caption: Independent tasks that share an upstream dependency run in parallel.

code:
Situation: a join is fast on most partitions, slow on a handful
Diagnosis: data skew
Fix: Adaptive Query Execution splits skewed partitions
caption: AQE can also broadcast the small dimension table automatically.

code:
Situation: a notebook needs a DB password, must not be hard-coded
Wrong: paste it into a notebook cell
Right: dbutils.secrets.get() against a secret scope
caption: Resolves at runtime; never shown in notebook output or history.
